intent.raw: define, design, and plan the candidate-only compound-domain-structure calibration experiment
intent.objective: Calibrate the residual-analysis hypothesis over three frozen fixtures with deterministic outcomes and no authority mutation.

subagent_strategy.trigger: W1 contains three disjoint fixture-receipt SWUs after W0 freezes shared contracts and evaluator behavior.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Each W1 worker writes one receipt subtree and reads one bounded fixture source; W0, W2, and W3 remain serialized.

roles.purpose: Build and validate exactly one frozen fixture receipt without evaluating or mutating its source.
roles.owns: One disjoint SWU among SWU-CDSC-003 through SWU-CDSC-005.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Approve W1 runtime subagents only after W0 passes, with one disjoint fixture SWU and the WORK-PACK receipt contract per worker.

boundaries.contract: Execute one selected SWU with explicit package-only write scope and return a receipt.
Fixture sources are pinned read-only evidence; all generated receipts and results stay in the calibration package.

boundaries.to_owner: DS-D1, DS-D8, pattern, and candidate governance
boundaries.contract: Fixture outcomes and suite verdicts cannot decide identity, relationship authority, pattern admission, replication, or promotion.
Reviewers freeze predicate values; evaluator computes residue and outcomes without inventing or revising them.

state_namespaces.write_policy: One selected SWU writes only its declared paths inside the calibration package.

state_namespaces.owner: GoldenQuill, Savvy, DS-D1, DS-D8, pattern, and candidate owners

steps.name: Author and validate Invoke package
stop_conditions: block if package claims a compound kind, identity, DS-D1, DS-D8, pattern, candidate, or promotion authority

steps.name: Freeze contracts and deterministic evaluator

outputs.ref: versioned contracts, manifest, evaluator, and tests

stop_conditions: block ambiguous semantic fields, incomplete outcome tables, evaluator-authored predicates, or source drift

steps.name: Produce frozen fixture receipts

outputs.ref: F1, F2, and F3 immutable evidence receipts

steps.evidence_artifact: W1 fixture receipts and join receipt
stop_conditions: block overlapping write scopes, fixture-source mutation, late predicate changes, or hidden indeterminate evidence

steps.name: Evaluate and append generation 1

outputs.ref: fixture results, suite verdict, and generation index

stop_conditions: block F2 control bypass, non-total outcome, replay drift, or in-place generation update

steps.name: Independently replay, audit, and route

outputs.ref: independent replay, audit, and bounded next-route receipt

stop_conditions: block replay mismatch, source mutation, missing uncertainty, or any identity/authority/promotion inference

gates.condition: Finite schemas, source pins, predicate coordinates, and total outcome tables pass before receipt production.
Three disjoint receipts validate and preserve indeterminate evidence and read-only source boundaries.
F2 is EXPLAINED before CALIBRATION-PASS is possible, and all frozen outputs replay identically.

gates.owner: DS-D1, DS-D8, pattern, and candidate governance
gates.condition: Calibration evidence may route later research but cannot change canonical authority or promotion state.

promotion_guardrails: Residual support is not identity, irreducibility, or portability.
Calibration pass is not replication, pattern admission, or promotion.
DS-D8 endpoint use is not DS-D1 formation authority.
Page and Layout remain roles with unreplicated pattern pressure.
Fixture and canonical source repositories remain read-only.
No experiment outcome directly enters a canonical promotion route.
